title: Indonesian Cosmetics Intelligence Dataset
description: Normalized BPOM cosmetics registry data, product details, and change-detection events.

eventType.title: Event Type
eventType.description: Change-detection classification of the record, such as NEW, CHANGED, UNCHANGED, or SNAPSHOT.

productType.title: Product Type
productType.description: Product type code returned by BPOM, for example KO for cosmetics.

registrationNumber.title: Registration Number
registrationNumber.description: BPOM registration number or Nomor Izin Edar (NIE).

issuedDate.title: Issued Date
issuedDate.description: Date the BPOM product registration was issued.

productName.title: Product Name
productName.description: Registered product name as published by BPOM.

packaging.title: Packaging
packaging.description: Registered packaging information published by BPOM.

composition.title: Composition
composition.description: Composition information displayed in the BPOM product detail.

dosageForm.title: Dosage Form
dosageForm.description: Dosage or product form when provided by BPOM.

applicationDate.title: Application Date
applicationDate.description: Registration application date when provided by BPOM.

expiryDate.title: Expiry Date
expiryDate.description: Registration expiry date when provided by BPOM.

status.title: Status
status.description: Registration status when provided by BPOM.

registrant.title: Registrant
registrant.description: Company or entity registered as the BPOM product registrant.

registrantLocation.title: Registrant Location
registrantLocation.description: Location of the product registrant as displayed in the BPOM listing.

cosmeticsManufacturer.title: Cosmetics Manufacturer
cosmeticsManufacturer.description: Cosmetics manufacturer or Industri Kosmetika shown in the BPOM product detail.

kits.title: Kits
kits.description: Kit information provided in the BPOM product detail.

issuedBy.title: Issued By
issuedBy.description: BPOM organizational unit responsible for issuing the registration.

category.title: Category
category.description: Normalized product category. For this Actor the value is Kosmetika.

sourceUrl.title: Source URL
sourceUrl.description: URL of the BPOM cosmetics registry used as the source.

matchedBy.title: Matched By
matchedBy.description: Input query that caused this record to be collected.

matches.title: Matches
matches.description: Multiple watchlist queries that matched the same registration.

scrapedAt.title: Scraped At
scrapedAt.description: Timestamp when the product was retrieved from BPOM.

detectedAt.title: Detected At
detectedAt.description: Timestamp when the Actor classified the record.

changedFields.title: Changed Fields
changedFields.description: Fields detected as changed compared with the previous stored snapshot.

previous.title: Previous Record
previous.description: Previous version of the record when eventType is CHANGED.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Main cosmetics intelligence fields for browsing BPOM products.

fullDetails.title: Full Details
fullDetails.description: Complete normalized BPOM record including technical and change-detection fields.
